title: "Media Debug Panel"
format: html

## Overview

The Media Widget provides a **Developer Mode** diagnostics panel, gated behind a checkbox at the bottom of the properties sidebar (`MediaPropertiesWidget`). When enabled, `MediaDebugPanel` shows real-time counts of scene elements managed by `Media_Window`.

Developer mode is off by default and persists via `MediaWidgetStateData::developer_mode` in workspace serialization.

## Components

| Component | Path | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| `MediaSceneDiagnostics` | `src/WhiskerToolbox/Media_Widget/Core/MediaSceneDiagnostics.hpp` | Lightweight count snapshot struct |
| `Media_Window::getSceneDiagnostics()` | `Rendering/Media_Window/Media_Window.hpp` | Reads internal QGraphicsScene vector sizes |
| `MediaDebugPanel` | `UI/MediaDebugPanel.hpp` | Collapsible `Section` with count labels |
| Toggle wiring | `UI/MediaPropertiesWidget.cpp` | Checkbox + panel visibility via `MediaWidgetState` |

## Scene Element Counts

The **Scene Elements** section reports counts from these `Media_Window` vectors:

- `line_paths`
- `masks`
- `mask_bounding_boxes`
- `mask_outlines`
- `points` (includes line dots, markers, and selection highlights)
- `intervals`
- `tensors`
- `text_items`
- `total_scene_items` (`QGraphicsScene::items().size()`)

Counts refresh automatically on `Media_Window::canvasUpdated`.

## Extension Roadmap

Future sections may include:

- Enabled data keys table (logical counts from `DataManager`)
- Viewport/zoom/pan readout
- `UpdateCanvas()` timing breakdown
- On-canvas overlays (if needed)
